candidate_rules.status: CANDIDATE - proposals for registration, not registered verdicts

CH1a_copy.rule: the top late head's mean copy C >= .10 logit with its interval above 0, and the sum of C over all late heads has its interval above 0 -> 'late heads write the attended picture's own label (OV copy)'; else 'not'
CH1a_copy.verdict: late heads write the attended picture's own label (OV copy)

CH1b_choice.rule: accuracy of argmax s (image-routed bridge) >= .60 and >= R1 - .05 -> 'the QK-OV-logit bridge reproduces the choice'; else 'not'

CH1c_logits.rule: pooled R2_id of s_c against Lc >= .30 with the lower bound > 0 -> 'the direct image-routed write accounts for the label-logit pattern'; else pooled Pearson >= .50 -> 'the bridge tracks the pattern at another scale (later processing rescales it)'; else 'not'
CH1c_logits.verdict: the direct image-routed write accounts for the label-logit pattern

CH2_margin.rule: Pearson(s_x - s_r, L_x - L_r) >= .50 with the lower bound > .30 -> 'the direct late writes predict the decision margin'; else 'not'

CH3_routes.rule: median top-1 signed share >= .50 -> 'single head'; else median top-3 signed share <= .50 and >= 2 late layers each carrying >= 15% of the chosen label's bridge score (ratio of sums) -> 'multi-route (several heads and layers add)'; else 'few heads'

CE_writer.rule: share of the chosen label's centred logit written directly by the late FA attention outputs (ratio of sums) >= .50 with the lower bound > .30 -> 'late attention writes the answer directly'; the same for the MLPs 51-63 -> 'the late MLPs write it'; else 'mixed'
CE_writer.verdict: late attention writes the answer directly
